title: Python Math & Random
description: Python has a built-in module 'math' that extends the list of mathematical functions. For generating random numbers, we use the 'random' module. These are critical for scientific computing and game development.
example:
// Math & Random Power
import math
import random

print(math.sqrt(64)) # 8.0
print(math.ceil(1.4)) # 2

# Random integers
print(random.randint(1, 10))
